## Compatibility / 兼容性

## Contributor notes / 投稿说明

- Target `main` from a short-lived branch in your fork or the upstream repository.
- Additional commits on the same branch update this PR.
- The maintainer reviews the change and squash-merges it; do not push to upstream `main`.
- Fork workflows wait for maintainer approval. CI approval does not grant merge or publishing access.
